integrity: The chronology is derived analytically from all twenty-seven first-choice functional graphs and replayed exhaustively on all 216 preference profiles by two independent exact TTC implementations.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for the three-agent Shapley--Scarf housing market with strict independent uniform preferences and the parallel convention that executes every current cycle in the same round. Sequential tie-breaking among disjoint cycles preserves the final allocation but changes the chronology statistic.
title: Exact three-agent cycle law for top trading cycles
